import os,re,json
def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load()
def f(I):
    H=len(I); W=len(I[0])
    color=max(set(sum(I,[]))-{0}) if set(sum(I,[]))-{0}!={0} else None
    col=min(set(sum(I,[]))-{0}) if set(sum(I,[]))-{0} else None
    # use the special color = one that's neither background nor majority... here background=8/6, seed=7/1
    from collections import Counter
    cnt=Counter(sum(I,[])); bg=cnt.most_common(1)[0][0]
    # seed color: the non-bg color appearing as a cluster (least common non-?) use: colors sorted by count, seed is second least? try colors present:
    cols=[c for c,_ in cnt.items() if c!=bg]
    seedcol=min(cols,key=lambda c:cnt[c])
    seeds=[(r,c) for r in range(H) for c in range(W) if I[r][c]==seedcol]
    sof={(r-min(p[0] for p in seeds),c-min(p[1] for p in seeds)) for r,c in seeds}
    out=[row[:] for row in I]
    for dr in range(-H,H):
        for dc in range(-W,W):
            t=[(r+dr,c+dc) for r,c in seeds]
            if (dr,dc)==(0,0): continue
            if any(not(0<=a<H and 0<=b<W) for a,b in t): continue
            if any(I[a][b]!=0 for a,b in t): continue
            for a,b in t: out[a][b]=seedcol
    return out
ok=all(f(G['Demo pair %d input'%i])==G['Demo pair %d output'%i] for i in [1])
print("demo ok:",ok)
out=f(G['Test input'])
print(json.dumps(out))
